assumptions: No intervention assignment, treated cohort, or counterfactual design is present in the committed aggregate source layer.
baseline: The bounded reference input contains 276,443 matching published service requests over 183 complete dates; it is workload evidence, not an outcome.

constraints.expression: no observed, causal, deployed, or impact claim from proposed effects

limitations: A causal question is retained as a negative evidence-gate test, not silently reduced to an associational claim.
Do not infer treatment effects from before/after request counts.
Do not use request status as verified service resolution or welfare impact.
question: Can the public aggregate snapshots identify a causal effect of a service intervention on area-level outcomes?
title: Philadelphia: Causal service-effectiveness gate
